subject: Security roadmap & MAP for AtlasPay evaluation
messages:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@atlaspay.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Devon Reed <devon.reed@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T17:12:00Z
Subject: Security roadmap & MAP for AtlasPay evaluation

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As we start scoping the mutual action plan (MAP) for our evaluation, the security and compliance gates are the primary dependency for our procurement timeline. To align expectations, can you confirm: 

- Whether Redwood can provide a completed SIG/CAIQ by our kickoff (we'd like to have a redline-ready copy before the PO).
- The current SOC 2 status and whether you can share the evidence index (system descriptions, control owner contact, last audit dates).
- DPA baseline and common redline carveouts (we'll likely request EU data residency and a 7-year limited retention clause).
- Typical timelines you see from MAP kickoff to production-enablement for a mid-sized PSP like AtlasPay (we're targeting an end-of-year go/no-go).

We'd like to capture these in a short MAP and meet next week (11/15) to finalize owners and dates. I've attached our shortlist of initial questions; Devon will follow up with a procurement calendar.

Att: atlaspay-compliance-asks.docx (referenced)

Best,
Ava Collins
Head of Security Operations
AtlasPay

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Devon Reed <devon.reed@atlaspay.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-08T20:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Security roadmap & MAP for AtlasPay evaluation

Hi Ava — thanks, and great to meet earlier. High level answers here and next steps below. I'm attaching a lightweight MAP tracker and our SOC 2 evidence index as a starter.

Summary: 
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a current CAIQ export; engineering and security can run a focused redline. We'll aim to have a CAIQ export and high-level responses in 3 business days.
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security) 2026-05; the evidence index lists auditors, control owners, and report dates. We can provide a read-only evidence packet for your review under an NDA.
- DPA & Data residency: Our standard DPA supports EU data residency via Dedicated/Private deployment. We surface a retention configuration — typical defaults are 90 days for logs, 1 year for non-sensitive telemetry, configurable for your account. EU residency + 7-year record retention is an exception request; we can scope it in the MAP and indicate impact on cost and SLA.
- Typical MAP timeline: For teams prioritizing security gating (SIG + SOC2 review + DPA negotiation), practical runway is 4–8 weeks to production sandbox access; compressed timelines are possible with pre-aligned owners.

Proposed next steps: 
1) We (Redwood security) will deliver: CAIQ export + SOC2 evidence index by 2026-11-11. (Attachment: SOC2-evidence-index.pdf)
2) Legal/Procurement redline: Redwood legal will send an initial DPA with EU residency option by 2026-11-13.
3) MAP meeting: 2026-11-15 10:00 UTC — confirm owners, retention windows, and sign-off criteria.

I've copied Karthik (product infra) for deployment/retention technical constraints and Laura (enterprise legal) for DPA/contract dialogue.

Attachments: MAP-Tracker-v1.xlsx; SOC2-evidence-index.pdf

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-08T21:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Security roadmap & MAP for AtlasPay evaluation — action items

Forwarding their asks — quick owner/estimate please so I can populate the MAP tracker before Friday. Excerpt from Ava below.

> "Can you confirm SIG/CAIQ by kickoff; SOC 2 evidence index; DPA baseline + EU residency and 7-year retention; typical MAP timeline?"

Ask for Karthik: can Dedicated/Private handle EU-at-rest + processing isolation for AtlasPay with our standard onboarding? If we need an escrow or additional controls for the 7-year retention requirement, flag cost delta and storage implications. Please call out any engineering lead time.

Ask for Laura: can you prepare a DPA draft with the EU residency option and a retention annex that shows the default windows and an escalation path for long-term retention requests (7+ years)? Also list legal sign-off dependencies.

Deliverable deadlines I told them: CAIQ + SOC2 index by 11/11; DPA draft by 11/13; MAP meeting 11/15. If this is impossible, propose alternate dates.

Thanks — Neha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security roadmap & MAP for AtlasPay evaluation — action items

Neha — quick notes: 
- EU residency: Supported via Redwood Dedicated (customer dataset pinned to eu-central-1). We can commit to at-rest residency for data and provide certs of location. Engineering lead time for a Dedicated tenant is typically 1–2 weeks once PO + infra input is in.
- 7-year retention: technically feasible but not recommended as default (cost/storage & backup windows). If AtlasPay requires 7-year retention for certain transaction logs, we should scope it as an annex and apply tiered storage (cold archive) — estimate +30–55% on storage cost depending on dataset size.
- SIG/CAIQ: Security will produce CAIQ export by 11/11.

I'll add these to the MAP tracker and flag the storage cost delta item for legal to annotate in the DPA.

—Karthik

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@atlaspay.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Devon Reed <devon.reed@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T19:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Security roadmap & MAP for AtlasPay evaluation

Neha / team — thanks for the swift reply and clear plan. 11/15 at 10:00 UTC works for us. A few clarifications ahead of the meeting: 

- We'll need the CAIQ export and SOC2 evidence index by 11/11 to circulate to our internal audit. Please mark any items that are "under remediation" so we can triage risk.
- For EU residency, AtlasPay requires both at-rest and in-region processing for cardholder-related tokens. We'll bring a short list of specific fields; expect to request a retention annex for transaction logs for 7 years.
- Procurement will route the PO subject to a clean DPA and a signed mutual MAP. Devon will share a procurement milestone calendar (HubSpot deal linked).

Looking forward to the MAP doc and speaking next week. If you can attach the SOC2 index directly to the HubSpot deal, that would speed review.

Thanks,
Ava Collins
Head of Security Operations
AtlasPay
